The autoregressive generation formulation (Figure5top) does not perform well, and even underperforms the classification baseline on element selection despite the larger model size (220M for Flan-T5 B ). We observe a substantial gain with MINDACT using the multi-choice QA formulation. The best model achieves 52.0% step success rate under Cross-Task setting, and 38.9% / 39.6% when generalizing to unseen websites and domains. However, the overall task success rate remains low for all models, as the agent often commits at least one error step in most cases.
